verdict.rationale: Formant documents its own in-product AI: users can "ask your fleet what's happening in plain language" and get ML-driven task recommendations with human approval. Its Analytics module also includes an AI assistant for building dashboards from device data. Together these cover the core of the story: AI insights and suggestions drawn from the user's data inside the product. However, the evidence is one-line marketing and doc claims. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the AI assistant generates insights (e.g., anomaly explanations, data summaries), any independent or hands-on corroboration that the plain-language querying and recommendations work as described.
